user.title: Pixoo 64 - Device & Media Player
user.description: Select your Pixoo 64 display and the media player you want to track.

data_description.pixoo_ip: Choose your auto-discovered Pixoo 64 or select manual entry.
data_description.media_player: The media player entity to monitor for playback and track details.
data_description.temperature_entity: Optional sensor entity to show ambient temperature on the display.

manual.title: Manual IP Entry
manual.description: Enter the local IP address of your Pixoo 64 device (e.g. 192.168.1.150).

data_description.pixoo_ip: Static local IP address assigned to your Pixoo 64.

lights.title: Ambient Light & WLED Sync
lights.description: Extract dominant colors from album covers and sync them dynamically in real-time.

data_description.light_entity: One or more RGB lights to match the album background color.
data_description.wled_ip: IP address of your WLED strip (without http://) for multi-color gradient effects.
data_description.only_at_night: Only activate light synchronization when the sun is below the horizon.

apis.title: Music Services & AI Art APIs
apis.description: Configure external services for high-resolution album artwork and AI fallbacks. All services below are free to use.

data_description.ai_model: AI model used to generate unique pixel art when no album cover is found.
data_description.pollinations_key: Optional key from https://pollinations.ai for higher rate limits. Free tier works without a key.
data_description.musicbrainz_enabled: Open-source community music database. Completely free with no API key required.
data_description.spotify_client_id: Enables high-res artwork, slider mode & artist slides. Get credentials at https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard
data_description.spotify_client_secret: Client Secret from your Spotify developer application (required if Client ID is provided).
data_description.tidal_client_id: For Tidal subscribers. Create an app at https://developer.tidal.com/dashboard to get your credentials.
data_description.tidal_client_secret: Client Secret from your Tidal developer app (required if Client ID is provided).
data_description.lastfm_key: Reliable artwork fallback. Get a free API Key at https://www.last.fm/api/account/create
data_description.discogs_token: Vinyl & rare album release fallback. Create a token at https://www.discogs.com/settings/developers

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Pixoo 64. Please ensure the device is powered on and the IP is correct.

error.tidal_id_required: Tidal Client ID is required when Client Secret is provided.
